revision.predicate_rule: Only links with statement_predicate_allowed=true or properties with assertion_allowed=true; predicate domain applies to subject entity, never ScientificStatement identity.
revision.immutability: Any change of S/P/O, polarity, qualifier or referenced scope creates a new revision; exact duplicates do not add evidence. A different independent proposition gets a different statement_id.
revision.atomicity: One independently judgeable proposition; split independent conjunctions, keep conditions and comparison operators attached to their proposition.
revision.negation: NEGATIVE denies only the qualified proposition. Not REQUIRED does not imply incompatible or DISCOURAGED; missing evidence never implies NEGATIVE.
revision.evidence_binding: Assessments point to exact revision IDs; do not require evidence to exist before recording an untrusted assertion.

Clustering allows information sharing between cells.
atomicity_examples.rule: No example is ingested, assessed or declared source-supported; each would need its own typed entity predicate mapping and evidence.

compatibility.AtomicClaimRevision: StatementRevision-compatible view only; V1 claim_id/claim_revision_id map conceptually to statement_id/statement_revision_id.

effect_policy.rule: A decision-bearing effect must use an already admitted typed assertion predicate with source assessment; if core cannot express it, defer for review instead of using display text. This is necessary evidence structure, not sufficient policy authorization.

external_governance: Review status, risk, trust and retrieval eligibility remain external; structural validity is not promotion.
